description: The task rules that the other cases do not use. AW-20: the newest edit per field wins; the first message is locked after the first session; a rekey of another device and a rekey from a stale key are ignored, the rekey of the creator counts; a human assigns the task before ubuntu-01 claims it; an agent cannot assign a task with no parent, a human can; the Confirm answer confirms the approach version of the gate file; the end of an unknown session is ignored. AW-21: a human assigns it before ubuntu-01 claims it; the gate file number is too large for a safe integer, so Confirm confirms the latest version. The project switch is on: the subtask AW-22 of the owner of the parent keeps its assignee, and a second agent assignment of AW-22 is ignored (the switch sets only the first assignment), the subtask AW-23 of another device does not.
